description: Up-facing faces at 72u (visible only at the apex of a jump) and 128u (never): wall tops, niche floors and the floor behind a 72u wall.

must_visible.why: 72u wall top: only an apex eye (85) is above its plane
72u niche floor: only an apex eye (85) is above it, and it sees in
floor behind the 72u wall: seen over the 8u rim from an apex eye, 157u past the eye and beyond
control: floor of the spawn zone
control: face of the 128u wall that looks at the spawn zone
control: face of the 72u wall that looks at the spawn zone

must_hidden.why: floor behind the 128u wall: no eye is high enough to look over it
back of the 128u wall's west face: every reachable eye is east of x=352

notes: VIS_TOP 72.0u (standing eye 64.0u, apex eye 85u), HID_TOP 128.0u. Zone V floor is seen from x>=1245 (nominal apex eye 85u).
